Daily Devotional

August 13

15 Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;) (Romans 2:15 KJV)

The conscience is the part of the soul that tells us what is right and wrong. It has to be part of the soul, as even a Christian’s conscience can be defiled (1 Corinthians 8:7), evil (Hebrews 10:22), and weak (1 Corinthians 8:7 & 10), but the born again spirit cannot be defiled. A good conscience is essential to our faith, as without it our faith is made shipwrecked (1 Timothy 1:19). A good conscience produces confidence (1 John 3:21 & Hebrews 10:35), whereas an evil conscience condemns us (1 John 3:20).

It is very likely that God created man without a conscience, and that we obtained it from the tree of good and evil when Adam sinned (Genesis 3:6). Since the function of the conscience is telling us what is good and evil, this only makes sense, as in the beginning God didn’t want man to know the evil things of this world. What a shame that Adam introduced sin into this world, as how wonderful it would be if man didn’t know anything about evil. As a Christian you should only think on good and holy things (Philippians 4:8), and not on evil things. Thank you Lord for forgiving us sinners.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
